human_editor_overrides.rationale: Preserves intensity in ordinary English without forcing uniform wording across contexts.

human_editor_overrides.decision: Do not render γάρ explicitly in Col.2.1. The backward link to Col.1.29 crosses a paragraph boundary and belongs to the study layer.
human_editor_overrides.rationale: The Human Editor judges the explicit English connector unnecessary in the reading text.

human_editor_overrides.decision: Open verse 2 with 'I am fighting so that' to make the purpose relationship explicit.
human_editor_overrides.rationale: Human Editor upheld the prior blocking audit finding that the purpose link should be audible on first hearing.

human_editor_overrides.decision: Render μυστήριον here as 'the secret God kept hidden — Christ Himself' rather than the Col.1.26 phrase 'secret plan'. This is a contextual variation under Matrix authority, not abandonment of the Col.1.26 precedent; Col.4.3 remains open.
human_editor_overrides.rationale: Makes the ἀπόκρυπτ- hidden chain audible across Col.1.26 → 2.2 → 2.3.

human_editor_overrides.decision: Render πληροφορία verbally as 'be completely sure' rather than with an abstract assurance noun. Record as a precedent for Col.4.12 πεπληροφορημένοι.
human_editor_overrides.rationale: Improves first-hearing clarity while retaining the force of full assurance.
Expresses the understanding concept in ordinary verbal English.

human_editor_overrides.decision: Render ἐπίγνωσις as 'come to know', consistent with Col.1.6, 1.9, and 1.10.
human_editor_overrides.rationale: Maintains the established knowing-language in natural English.

human_editor_overrides.decision: Deliberately omit an explicit rendering of πᾶν πλοῦτος in favor of first-hearing clarity. The πλοῦτος → θησαυροί handoff to verse 3 is knowingly forfeited. Do not restore it in a later pass without a new Human Editor ruling.
human_editor_overrides.rationale: The Human Editor accepts this controlled semantic compression for oral clarity.

human_editor_overrides.decision: Render συμβιβασθέντες as the participial phrase 'bound together in love' riding on 'take heart', not as a coordinate finite clause. Col.2.19 remains open.
human_editor_overrides.rationale: Preserves the relationship in smoother English.

human_editor_overrides.decision: Retain 'talk you into believing something false, no matter how convincing the argument sounds.' Three smoothing passes diagnosed a soft cadence, but no proposed repair improved it.
human_editor_overrides.rationale: The wording preserves the deceive-by-reasoning sense of παραλογίζομαι in immediately understandable English.

verse_renderings.text: I want you to know how fiercely I am fighting for you, and for the believers in Laodicea, and for everyone who has never met me in person.

I am fighting so that all these believers will take heart, bound together in love. I want them to understand deeply, to be completely sure, and so at last to know the secret God kept hidden — Christ Himself.
In Christ every treasure of wisdom and knowledge lies hidden.
I am telling you this so that no one can talk you into believing something false, no matter how convincing the argument sounds.
Even though I am not there in person, I am with you in spirit. I am glad to see how well you are holding together and how secure your trust in Christ is.

reader_notes.anchor: the secret God kept hidden — Christ Himself
reader_notes.text: The SBLGNT reads “God’s secret, Christ,” identifying Christ Himself as the secret. Some manuscripts expand the wording at this point; FLT follows the SBLGNT reading.
The Greek expression translated “be completely sure” describes full assurance or settled confidence, not merely a passing feeling of certainty.

Paul’s repeated emphasis on “wisdom” and “knowledge” in this section likely takes up vocabulary valued by the teachers he is opposing. His point is that every true treasure of wisdom and knowledge is found in Christ.

Paul uses two terms that can evoke a military formation. Taxis can describe ordered ranks, and stereōma can describe firmness or a solid front. Together they picture a community holding its formation under pressure.

constrained_phrase_flags.rationale: This is the natural English expression of τῷ πνεύματι σὺν ὑμῖν εἰμι; retain as constrained wording subject to the deferred hard audit.
